ux.claim.countValidation: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000 for each count.
ux.claim.awardServer: Approval awards XP from the adjusted counts using the current server rules. The server calculates the final award.
ux.claim.rejectRequired: To reject, enter 3–1,000 characters explaining why.
ux.operations.archiveBody: Historical PR reports and payouts are kept here for reference. Use Claim XP for current submissions and reviews.
ux.recap.saved: Saved · editable until HQ locks the recap
ux.recap.saveHint: Save updates the event recap. HQ locking closes editing.
ux.recap.validation: Counts must be whole numbers from 0 to 1,000,000. Revenue must be 0–2,000,000,000. Fill in both responsible staff fields; notes can have up to 2,000 characters.
ux.card.handoverNfcRequired: Handover requires a compatible physical iPhone with NFC and the physical card. Open this task on that device to read and verify the card.
ux.card.encodeNfcRequired: Writing a card requires a compatible physical iPhone with NFC and the physical card. QR or NIM can identify the member but cannot complete the NFC write.
ux.card.identificationOnly: Look up status; physical NFC is still required for handover.
ux.card.repairReplaceGuide: Chip responds and card is present: repair encoding with HQ approval. Card lost or chip does not respond: replace the card and permanently invalidate the old card.
ux.card.chipQuestion: Is the card present and does its chip respond?
ux.card.replaceConsequences: Permanent action: the old card token and UID will be refused. A replacement enters the print queue with the applicable replacement fee. Follow up payment in the authorized dashboard.
ux.card.repairConsequences: For a delivered card with a responding chip: request HQ approval for one repair. Only the requester can use the approved grant before its deadline.
ux.card.repairNotAvailable: Request repair from an authorized city account for a delivered card. HQ manages approvals in the dashboard.
ux.card.replacementNext: Replacement card: check the print queue and replacement-fee payment with the member.
ux.card.paymentRefresh: Find this member by NIM in Payments. Return here and refresh the status after recording payment.
ux.reencode.requesterOnly: Only the original requester can perform this repair.
ux.reencode.next.PENDING: Wait for the HQ decision before writing the card.
ux.reencode.next.APPROVED: The requester can repair the physical card once before the deadline.
ux.reencode.next.EXPIRED: This grant cannot be used. Submit a new request if the chip still responds.
ux.reencode.next.USED: This grant cannot be reused. Verify the repaired card; request help if it still fails.
ux.reencode.next.REJECTED: Read the HQ decision note before choosing the next action.
ux.encode.stageVerify: 2 · Verify the member and card before writing
ux.encode.reportOnly: The physical write has completed. Retry only the server report; do not write the card again.
ux.recap.lockConfirm: Lock the saved version of this event recap? Editing will be closed. Save or discard your changes before locking.
ux.claim.reasonTooLong: The rejection reason can have up to 1,000 characters.
ux.reencode.deadlineUnavailable: The grant deadline is unavailable. Refresh the status or ask HQ before repairing.

ux.social.receivedOutsideApp: Record only a deposit already received outside the app. This does not charge the member.
